oliver.p: Heads-up 11we're seeing stale vector-search results in eu-west1 since ~09:18 UTC. Customers report old documents surfacing for queries that should return recent writes. Opening incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3301234567

sre-maya: Investigating 11traces/metrics show embed-store read replicas lagging ~300-450s behind primary. Replication apply backlog spiked after a large ingestion batch.

eng-embed-julie: We rolled a throughput change to the ingestion pipeline yesterday (batch-size + parallelism). That likely increased the write tail and exposed replica apply limits. Pulling write logs now to confirm offending jobs.

cs-omar: Notifying CS + affected accounts; customers seeing stale search: org-42, org-77, org-101. Drafting proactive comms.

eng-embed-julie: Short-term mitigation suggestions: 1) throttle background ingestion for noisy orgs, 2) increase replica apply workers, 3) promote a caught-up replica if safe. Recommend starting with throttle.

sre-maya: Agreed. Implementing pause on non-critical ingestion jobs and ramping replica apply concurrency in eu-west1. Starting canary pause on one shard now.

ops-bot: action: ingest-pause/shard-12 canary=true started at 3301234576

sre-maya: Canary results (5m): replication lag on canary shard dropped from ~420s -> ~12s after pausing ingestion and adding 2 apply workers. No downstream errors observed.

eng-embed-julie: Applying global config: embed-store/replica-apply-parallelism=+4 and reverting ingestion batch-size bump for the pipeline. Rolling in eu-west1.

cs-omar: Customer comms sent to affected orgs; posting public status update shortly.

status-page-bot: Public status posted: "Investigating 11Vector search results in eu-west1 may return stale content due to replication backlog. Mitigations are in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3301234567

eng-embed-julie: Owners for RCA and follow-ups: eng-embed (julie), eng-data (mike-b), eng-sre (maya). Action items: add replication-lag alert (threshold 60s), enforce backpressure in ingestion pipeline, run capacity test for batch-size changes, and produce postmortem within 48h.

sre-maya: Keeping incident open for a 30m monitoring window. If lag reappears, page oncall.

oliver.p: Thanks all. Will evaluate customer exposure for credits if impact exceeds 1h. :thumbsup:
